citation.title: Deep learning-based 3D multigrid topology optimization of manufacturable designs
citation.authors: Jaydeep Rade, Anushrut Jignasu, Ethan Herron, Ashton Corpuz, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian, Soumik Sarkar, Aditya Balu, Adarsh Krishnamurthy

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports more than fourfold faster distributed neural-network training than the non-distributed training setup, with similar model performance; it does not quantify improvement over classical topology optimization.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: The abstract's >4x factor compares ML training variants, not classical versus ML runtime.
claim.alternatives: Abstract says 128^3 model outputs are enabled by multigrid training, and over 60,000 topology optimization examples are generated.

baseline.data_generation_cost: over 60,000 optimization examples; computation cost not stated (abstract)

notes: Searches found a publisher abstract and author publication links pointing to the journal page, but no open full text. The abstract promises dataset release; availability was not verifiable. The >4x result is an ML-versus-ML training comparison.
